**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 12.3** expressly confirms we are unrestricted in developing, acquiring, licensing, selling or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, or operating in any field or territory, and that we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. This exceeds our preferred position.
- **§ 12.4** is the only competition restraint, and it binds Brightline (Vendor), not us — a benefit to our side, so not flagged.
- **§ 13.4** licence restrictions are standard anti-abuse limits (no reverse engineering of hosted source, no interference, no unlawful use) with carve-outs for law-mandated rights and authorized security testing; they are not field-of-use or competitive restraints.
- Full-text searches for "compete/competing", "exclusiv", "field", "territory", and "shall not develop" surfaced no restriction on our business lines.
